theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lura_c1_image_lipschitz_null_rectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G D → (∀ K : Set (Euclid d), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzOnWith L G K) ∧ (∀ S : Set (Euclid d), S ⊆ D → μHE[m] S = 0 → μHE[m] (G '' S) = 0) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Euclid d), S ⊆ D → CountablyRectifiable m S → CountablyRectifiable m (G '' S)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
